comment: The Song mode scoreboard's songs (scoreboard.py). Each song folder (bench/songs/bitmidi/<slug>/, git-ignored) holds audio.wav and the key named here. split: dev songs are tuned on; holdout songs are only reported, never tuned on. pitchAlternates: extra keys of the same song for pitch-based scores (chords, notes, parts), used when the recording's tuning sits between two semitones; each pitch metric takes the best of the keys, beats and downbeats come from the main key. beatLevels: metrical levels the objective accepts for the beat F1 ('asIs', 'double', 'half'); 'double' means the app may count twice the key's tempo. weak: metrics whose key is a rough guide on this song (reported, still scored). See README.md, 'Scoreboard'.

songs.title: Toto - Africa
songs.notes: Key has six 2/4 bars (app keeps 4/4, caps downbeats near 0.5); countermelody is mostly bass doublings plus the flute solo.

songs.title: Queen - Bohemian Rhapsody
songs.style: rock opera, tempo and meter changes
songs.notes: Downbeats corrected by hand after a skipped 2/4 bar; medium confidence after 199 s. Rock section 137 BPM (dotted-quarter beat) could also be felt at half speed.

songs.title: Coldplay - Viva la Vida
songs.notes: No melody or bass in the key; 59% of the song scored. Chords pushed an eighth early on the record, so per-beat chords top out near 87-90%.

songs.title: Dr. Dre - Still D.R.E.
songs.notes: Recording tuned -49 cents, between A minor and Bb minor: pitch scores take the better of the Bb key (truth.json) and the A key (truth-a-minor.json). No melody (rapped). Key built from a corrected 2-bar loop.

songs.title: Rick Astley - Never Gonna Give You Up
songs.notes: Many look-alike chord pairs (Fm7 = Ab6, Bbm7 = Db6); chords pushed half a beat early in the chorus.

songs.title: Michael Jackson - Billie Jean
songs.notes: Chord labels follow the stabs over a pedal bass (E:maj7 on beat 2, N on beat 3); two arrangements agree on only 58% of roots.

songs.title: Stevie Wonder - Superstition
songs.notes: Chords labelled per half bar. Alignment needed trust overrides (88% scored); beats cross-checked against an independent tracker (F1 0.99).

songs.title: Dave Brubeck - Take Five
songs.notes: 5/4 at 171 BPM; the app's auto meter chooses 3, 4 or 5 beats per bar. Vamp beat 4 relabelled Bb:min7 (post-edit).

songs.title: John Denver - Take Me Home, Country Roads
songs.notes: Key counts 82 BPM (cut time) with two 2-beat bars; the 164 BPM boom-chick pulse is just as valid, so the objective accepts the key at double tempo for beats.

songs.title: The Beatles - Let It Be
songs.notes: 96.5% scored; 12-57 s (piano and voice) is the least certain beat span. About 10% of chord time has a debatable root (F6 read as Dm7, C/G as G).
